expandtemplates.wikitext: @@name@@Goes Where He Pleases@@icon@@false@@icon2@@Goes Where He Pleases.png@@icon3@@{{{icon3}}}@@icon4@@{{{icon4}}}@@description@@'''Innate:''' '''Dr. Mundo''' [[File:Health regeneration icon.svg|15px|link=Health regeneration]] regenerates an additional「 0.4% – 2.3% (based on level) of his [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''maximum''' health every 5 seconds. 」「 0.04% – 0.23% (based on level) of his [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] '''maximum''' health every 0.5 seconds. 」@@description2@@'''Passive:''' Periodically, '''Dr. Mundo''' gains immunity to the next hostile [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|immobilizing]] effect to affect him. Upon resisting one, '''Dr. Mundo''' pays a health cost equal to 4% of his '''current''' health and propels a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of the immobilization source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds.@@description3@@'''Dr. Mundo''' can move near the canister to consume it, [[File:Heal power icon.svg|20px|link=Healing|An icon representing the keyword Heal]] [[:Healing|healing]] himself for 4% of his '''maximum''' health and reducing the [[File:Cooldown icon.png|15px|link=Cooldown]] cooldown of ''Goes Where He Pleases'' by 15 seconds. Enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champions]] can move near it to destroy it.@@description4@@''Goes Where He Pleases' '' cooldown resets upon [[respawn|respawning]].@@description5@@{{{description5}}}@@description6@@{{{description6}}}@@leveling@@{{{leveling}}}@@leveling2@@{{{leveling2}}}@@leveling3@@{{{leveling3}}}@@leveling4@@{{{leveling4}}}@@leveling5@@{{{leveling5}}}@@leveling6@@{{{leveling6}}}@@range@@{{{range}}}@@radius@@{{{radius}}}@@effectradius@@{{{effect radius}}}@@width@@{{{width}}}@@speed@@{{{speed}}}@@casttime@@{{{cast time}}}@@cost@@{{{cost}}}@@cooldown@@{{{cooldown}}}@@targeting@@Passive@@damagetype@@{{{damagetype}}}@@spellshield@@{{{spellshield}}}@@projectile@@false@@notes@@ * Upon being triggered by a hostile [[File:Stun icon.png|20px|link=Crowd_control#Immobilizing|An icon representing the keyword Immobilize]] [[:Crowd_control#Immobilizing|immobilizing]] effect, ''Goes Where He Pleases'' will also grant '''Dr. Mundo''' immunity to additional immobilizing effects from the same [[:Champion ability|cast instance]]. ** Abilities where non-immobilizing effects and damage are nested into immobilizing ones will have them also prevented. Non-immobilizing effects and damage applied separately (the vast majority of cases) are not prevented. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] and [[File:Morgana Black Shield.png|20xpx|border|link=Morgana#Black Shield|An icon for Morgana's ability Black Shield]] [[Morgana#Black Shield|Black Shield]] take priority over ''Goes Where He Pleases''. * The canister, whether in flight and on the ground, will transition in and out of [[File:Mordekaiser OriginalSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Mordekaiser|An icon representing Mordekaiser]] [[Mordekaiser|Mordekaiser's]] [[File:Mordekaiser Realm of Death.png|20xpx|border|link=Mordekaiser#Realm of Death|An icon for Mordekaiser's ability Realm of Death]] [[Mordekaiser#Realm of Death|Death Realm]] alongside ''Dr. Mundo''.(unexpected) * The canister cannot be interacted with while [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]].@@
